Chapter 957 Chapter 17: Clashing With The Ultimate (Please Subscribe) _2

Chapter 957  Chapter 17: Clashing with the Ultimate (Please Subscribe) _2

In this situation, their group of a dozen twelfth-tier ultimates coming to fight in earnest has turned into a joke.

Lin Yuan's rules have reached such heights that, although still an eleventh-tier life form, he is far from being an opponent for these twelfth tiers.

But it also completely eliminates the possibility of being suppressed.

That's because Lin Yuan is fully capable of self-destructing this avatar before he could be suppressed.

As for the idea of contaminating Lin Yuan with that drop of bizarre blood, the premise is that he must be thoroughly suppressed, to the point where even his thoughts cannot function.

But now.

This possibility is infinitely close to zero.

Lin Yuan is no fool. Upon sensing that he might be suppressed, he would surely self-destruct first.

For a moment, including the Tianyu Clan ancestor, over ten twelfth-tier ultimates fell into an eerie silence.

"What goes around comes around."

"Receive my strike."

Lin Yuan slightly smiled, took a step forward, and threw a punch directly.

This punch carried the comprehension of the seventh realm of Space-Time, collapsing space-time wherever the punch went, heading straight for the bewildered standing Tianyu Clan ancestor.

"Not good."

As the direct target of this punch, the Tianyu Clan ultimate's face drastically changed. He could feel that while the punch's level of power wasn't high, the space-time rules it pulled were vast and mighty.

Even for a twelfth-tier like him, getting hit by this punch would be far from pleasant.

The Tianyu Clan ancestor was about to react.

Immediately following.

The Tianyu Clan ancestor then saw Lin Yuan's eyes.

What profound eyes they were, endlessly deep, as if linked to some mysterious abyss.

Mind Will Secret Technique—

Abyssal Eye.

This was the reward Lin Yuan chose after passing the seventh floor of the Magic Jade Tower with an eleventh-tier life level.

It is a rare mind will attack technique.

Now, as Lin Yuan's mind will has reached forty million points, equivalent to the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm, employing this mind will secret technique to use the Abyssal Eye, even a twelfth-tier ultimate with a robust life essence would be momentarily stunned.

Boom.

Lin Yuan's punch didn't hit the Tianyu Clan ancestor directly, but the vast power of Space-Time carried by it surged right into him.

"You?!"

The Tianyu Clan ancestor's face turned pale, he barely recovered from the influence of the Abyssal Eye, only to feel the unsettling chaos within his breath, and even the cosmos inside was shaking.

The Tianyu Clan ancestor took seven or eight steps back before he barely stabilized.

Looking towards Lin Yuan, his gaze revealed an unprecedented seriousness.

In just those few moments, Lin Yuan demonstrated two methods that could threaten a twelfth-tier ultimate.

One was that direct attack on his mental will which trapped the Tianyu Clan ancestor for several breaths.

Partly because the Tianyu Clan ancestor had not considered Lin Yuan as a real opponent.

Even though Lin Yuan showed a rule comprehension surpassing their twelfth-tier ultimate, the Tianyu Clan ancestor hadn't paid much attention.

After all, comprehending the rules is one thing, and the power of the attack is another.

With a world-sized internal universe spanning a hundred thousand light-years, even an eleventh-tier life form like Lin Yuan attacking wouldn't break through the defense.

But that kind of mental attack technique, coupled with the punch Lin Yuan threw, truly shocked the heart of the Tianyu Clan ancestor.

"What?"

"A punch from Galaxy Master?"

"How is that possible?"

The dozen or so other twelfth-tier ultimates around were equally incredulous.

They were still immersed in the bizarre rule comprehension of Galaxy Master, yet they found that the punch he threw reached the power level of a twelfth-tier?

Otherwise, it wouldn't have forced the Tianyu Clan ancestor to retreat seven or eight steps!

"It's a pity... I am just a Primordial Spirit now. If it was my true form that threw this punch, it could at least injure this ultimate from the Tianyu Clan."

Lin Yuan sighed inwardly upon seeing this.

Compared to his real body, the Taiyang Divine Spirit was vastly inferior. His real body's inner world had reached eleven light-years, while the Taiyang Divine Spirit? Barely over one light-year.

The gap in their inner worlds alone was like a chasm. Without the perception from the Seventh Realm of the Space-Time Rule and the support of the Chaos Rule in the dark, unleashing one thousand percent of his strength, the ancestors of the Tianyu Clan probably wouldn't even consider retreating.

...

"What is this?"

"The Galaxy Master's punch made that old guy from the Tianyu Clan step back seven or eight steps?"

The Xuanyuan Supreme, who was rapidly approaching, was somewhat stupefied. He also knew that Lin Yuan's real body was in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, meaning what was here at most was merely a clone.

A clone, without the aid of any twelfth-layer weapons or treasures, merely relying on its own power, made a twelfth layer ultimate step back seven or eight steps?

What does this imply?

The Galaxy Master is merely at the eleventh layer. The disparity in life levels and inner worlds, the difference with a twelfth layer ultimate is unimaginable.

And yet he managed to execute a strike on the level of a twelfth layer ultimate purely with his own strength?

"Even if his perception of rules is high, reaching the peak of the Sixth Realm or even the Seventh Realm of Space-Time Rule, with that life level, how is it possible to shake a twelfth layer ultimate?"

Xia Qin, the Supreme, also found it unbelievable.

It was not a matter of doubting Lin Yuan, but the scene before them simply shouldn't have occurred.

...

Robber Clan territory.

The deepest, unknowable area.

In front of an unremarkable wooden house.

The ultimate of the Robber Clan sat there, with a scene appearing in front of him where more than ten twelfth layer ultimates surrounded Lin Yuan.

As one of the most mysterious clans in the universe and one of the only two at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, this ultimate of the Robber Clan naturally had the means to glimpse the scene before the space-time black hole.

"Impressive."

The ultimate of the Robber Clan outside the wooden house murmured to himself, he also saw the scene of Lin Yuan punching back the ultimate of the Tianyu Clan, sensing the terrifying rule fluctuations contained in that punch.

"A punch from a clone, reaching the power level of the twelfth layer?"

A voice also came from inside the wooden house, the tone carrying shock, this scene held too much information.

They could tell that Lin Yuan's punch did not rely on any external power, but this made it even more unbelievable.

"It seems that the gaze that spied on this place not long ago must have been the Galaxy Master." the ultimate of the Robber Clan outside murmured.

Although he did not understand how Lin Yuan managed to throw that punch, the perception of rules involved, especially the Space-Time Rule, was beyond even his comprehension.

In such circumstances, considering the gaze that spied on them earlier... it seems this ultimate of the Robber Clan was almost certain the source was indeed the Galaxy Master.

"My Robber Clan has experienced multiple Cosmic Eras, witnessed countless geniuses, and there were lives that reached the peak of the Path Splitting Realm even before the great cosmic destruction, but the Galaxy Master?"

The ultimate of the Robber Clan outside continued speaking in a low voice, filled with awe.

Other major peak clan powers only think the Robber Clan originated from the last Cosmic Era, but the history of the Robber Clan goes much beyond just the last one.

Over the long years, through the many Cosmic Eras this universe has undergone, the Robber Clan's presence was there, but the great cosmic destruction erased much information about them, leaving only bits from the last Cosmic Era to this one.

In all these Cosmic Eras, the two ultimate ancestors of the Robber Clan had witnessed countless geniuses, but compared to the Galaxy Master?

No.

Those so-called geniuses, those lives that stepped into the peak of Path Splitting Realm before the great cosmic destruction, simply do not qualify to be compared with the Galaxy Master.

"Fortunately, you didn't agree to those twelfth layer ultimates' plan to surround and kill the Galaxy Master." The voice inside the wooden house said.

Given the strength that the Galaxy Master currently demonstrates, it's predictable that even if both ultimates of the Robber Clan took action, they could at most kill the Galaxy Master's this particular clone.

But what about the Galaxy Master's real body?

Even before stepping into the twelfth layer, a clone of the Galaxy Master managed to achieve twelfth-layer-level power in direct combat, what about once he truly steps into the twelfth layer?

The combat power of the Galaxy Master then, how tremendous would it be?

The ultimate of the Robber Clan originally thought, after the Galaxy Master steps into the twelfth layer, there was a high possibility of becoming a peak Path Splitting Realm life before the end of this Cosmic Era.

But now?

Why wait until the end of this Cosmic Era?

As soon as the Galaxy Master steps into the twelfth layer, undergoing a drastic transformation and leap in life level...

Within this universe, which of the twelfth layer ultimates could possibly be a match for the Galaxy Master?
